SELECT id AS "id", username AS "username", display_name AS "displayName", role AS "role", enabled AS "enabled", last_login_at AS "lastLoginAt", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", name AS "name", protocol::text AS "protocol", endpoint AS "endpoint", status AS "status" FROM driver WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT d.id AS "modelId", d.code AS "code", d.name AS "name", d.device_type AS "deviceType", d.vendor AS "vendor", d.icon AS "icon", c.code AS "capability", (SELECT count(*) FROM device_instance di WHERE di.device_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "deployed" FROM device d LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = d.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY "deployed" DESC, d.name

SELECT w.id AS "id", w.code AS "code", w.name AS "name", (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task') AS "nodeCount" FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.category = 'choreography' ORDER BY w.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.status AS "status", r.control_state AS "controlState", r.expanded_steps AS "expandedSteps", r.current_seq AS "currentSeq", r.started_at AS "startedAt", r.finished_at AS "finishedAt", r.error AS "error", r.pause_kind AS "pauseKind", r.pause_reason AS "pauseReason", r.stop_requested AS "stopRequested", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "durationSec" FROM experiment_run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT occurred_at AS "occurredAt", username AS "username", action AS "action", entity_type AS "entityType", entity_id AS "entityId", result AS "result", ip AS "ip", "before" AS "before", "after" AS "after" FROM audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND (#{param2}::text IS NULL OR action = #{param2}) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT id AS "id", node_count AS "nodeCount", edge_count AS "edgeCount", length(xml) AS "bytes", saved_at AS "savedAt" FROM workflow_graph_history WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} ORDER BY saved_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT dm.method AS "method", dm.name AS "name", c.code AS "capability", (dm.param_schema->'params')::text AS "params" FROM device_method dm LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dm.capability_id WHERE dm.tenant_id = #{param1} AND dm.method = #{param2} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id AS "resourceId", d.code AS "code", d.name AS "name", di.ip AS "ip", c.code AS "capability" FROM resource_node d LEFT JOIN resource_node p ON p.id = d.parent_id LEFT JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} AND d.kind = 'device' AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.kind <> 'island') AND di.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.code

SELECT from_workcell_id AS "fromWorkcellId", to_workcell_id AS "toWorkcellId", carrier AS "carrier", status AS "status", remark AS "remark" FROM experiment_handoff WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY from_workcell_id, to_workcell_id

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.error_code AS "errorCode", r.input->>'quarantineReason' AS "reason", r.created_at::text AS "createdAt", (SELECT er.experiment_id FROM experiment_run_step s JOIN experiment_run er ON er.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND er.id = s.experiment_run_id WHERE s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.run_id = r.id LIMIT 1) AS "experimentId" FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.status = 'quarantined' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT id AS "id", manual_window_id AS "manualWindowId", run_id AS "runId", experiment_run_id AS "experimentRunId", operator AS "operator", decided_action AS "decidedAction", plate_barcode AS "plateBarcode", sample_id AS "sampleId", from_location AS "fromLocation", to_location AS "toLocation", result AS "result", note AS "note", created_at::text AS "createdAt" FROM intervention_record WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT ew.workcell_id AS "workcellId", rn.name AS "name" FROM experiment_workcell ew LEFT JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.tenant_id = ew.tenant_id AND rn.id = ew.workcell_id WHERE ew.tenant_id = #{param1} AND ew.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY ew.workcell_id

mapper.select: SELECT p.code AS "code", p.name AS "name", p.x AS "x", p.y AS "y", p.z AS "z", p.action AS "action", r.code AS "deviceCode" FROM robot_point p LEFT JOIN resource_node r ON r.id = p.device_resource_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.island_id = #{param2} ORDER BY p.robot_resource_id, p.code
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_node SET attr = COALESCE(attr, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('pos_x', #{param3}, 'pos_y', #{param4}), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND kind = 'device'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS "id", p.robot_resource_id AS "robotResourceId", p.code AS "code", p.name AS "name", p.x AS "x", p.y AS "y", p.z AS "z", p.action AS "action", p.device_resource_id AS "deviceResourceId", r.code AS "deviceCode", p.synced_at AS "syncedAt" FROM robot_point p LEFT JOIN resource_node r ON r.id = p.device_resource_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.island_id = #{param2} ORDER BY p.robot_resource_id, p.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO robot_point (tenant_id, island_id, robot_resource_id, code, name, device_resource_id, action, synced_at) SELECT #{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, d.code, d.name, d.id, 'PickPlace', now() FROM resource_node d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} AND d.parent_id = #{param2} AND d.kind = 'device' AND d.id <> #{param3} ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, robot_resource_id, code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, device_resource_id = EXCLUDED.device_resource_id, synced_at = now(), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT eo.id AS "id", eo.fingerprint AS "fingerprint", eo.outcome AS "outcome", eo.severity::text AS "severity", eo.attempt AS "attempt", eo.run_id AS "runId", eo.run_node_id AS "runNodeId", eo.resource_id AS "resourceId", eo.occurred_at AS "occurredAt", eo.message AS "message" FROM error_occurrence eo WHERE eo.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY eo.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND kind = 'island'
mapper.update: UPDATE device_instance SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND resource_id = #{param2} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE recovery_policy SET strategy = COALESCE(#{param3}::recovery_strategy, strategy), max_attempts = COALESCE(#{param4}, max_attempts), priority = COALESCE(#{param5}, priority), enabled = COALESCE(#{param6}, enabled), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT a.fingerprint AS "fingerprint", a.status AS "status", a.note AS "note", a.assignee AS "assignee", a.closed_at AS "closedAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt", r.code AS "deviceCode", r.name AS "deviceName", ds.online AS "online", ds.last_heartbeat AS "lastHeartbeat", CASE WHEN ds.online = false THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ds.last_heartbeat))::bigint ELSE NULL END AS "offlineSec" FROM alert_state a LEFT JOIN resource_node r ON a.fingerprint = 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|' || r.id LEFT JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = r.id AND ds.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{param1} AND a.fingerprint LIKE 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.status = 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT h.id AS "id", h.experiment_id AS "experimentId", e.experiment_no AS "experimentNo", h.from_workcell_id AS "fromWorkcellId", rf.name AS "fromName", h.to_workcell_id AS "toWorkcellId", rt.name AS "toName", h.status AS "status", h.carrier AS "carrier", h.remark AS "remark" FROM experiment_handoff h JOIN experiment e ON e.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND e.id = h.experiment_id LEFT JOIN resource_node rf ON rf.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND rf.id = h.from_workcell_id LEFT JOIN resource_node rt ON rt.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND rt.id = h.to_workcell_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{param1} AND h.status = #{param2} ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT d.id AS "resourceId", d.code AS "code", d.name AS "name", di.ip AS "ip", c.code AS "capability", dev.icon AS "icon", (SELECT p.id FROM resource_node p WHERE p.id = d.parent_id AND p.kind = 'island') AS "islandId", (SELECT p.code FROM resource_node p WHERE p.id = d.parent_id AND p.kind = 'island') AS "islandCode" FROM resource_node d JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} AND d.kind = 'device' AND (#{param2}::bigint IS NULL OR d.parent_id = #{param2}) ORDER BY d.code

SELECT e.fingerprint AS "fingerprint", max(e.error_code_id) AS "codeId", max(e.resource_id) AS "resourceId", count(*) AS "hitCount", min(e.occurred_at) AS "firstAt", max(e.occurred_at) AS "lastAt", max(e.severity::text) AS "severity", (array_agg(e.outcome ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC))[1] AS "lastOutcome", (array_agg(e.message ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC))[1] AS "lastMessage", COALESCE(max(s.status), 'open') AS "state", max(s.assignee) AS "assignee", max(s.note) AS "note" FROM error_occurrence e LEFT JOIN alert_state s ON s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND s.fingerprint = e.fingerprint WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND e.severity::text <> 'info' AND e.resolved_at IS NULL GROUP BY e.fingerprint ORDER BY "hitCount" DESC, "lastAt" DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM error_code WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND code = #{param2}) AS "codeExists", (SELECT count(*) FROM error_occurrence e JOIN error_code c ON c.id = e.error_code_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND c.code = #{param2}) AS "historyHits", (SELECT count(*) FROM recovery_policy p LEFT JOIN error_code c ON c.id = p.error_code_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.enabled AND p.priority < #{param3} AND (p.error_code_id IS NULL OR c.code = #{param2})) AS "shadowed"

SELECT i.id AS "id", i.code AS "code", i.name AS "name", d.id AS "devId", d.code AS "devCode", d.name AS "devName", dev.model AS "model", dev.vendor AS "vendor", dev.icon AS "icon", c.code AS "capability", di.id AS "instanceId", di.ip AS "ip", dr.endpoint AS "driverEndpoint", dr.code AS "driverCode", (d.attr->>'pos_x')::numeric AS "posX", (d.attr->>'pos_y')::numeric AS "posY", COALESCE(ds.online, false) AS "online", COALESCE(ds.status, 'idle') AS "devStatus", ds.current_method AS "currentMethod", ds.has_plate AS "hasPlate" FROM resource_node i LEFT JOIN resource_node d ON d.parent_id = i.id AND d.kind = 'device' LEFT JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id LEFT JOIN driver dr ON dr.id = di.driver_id AND dr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = d.id AND ds.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{param1} AND i.kind = 'island' ORDER BY i.code, d.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (tenant_id, username, display_name, role, password_hash, salt) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6})
mapper.select: INSERT INTO error_code (tenant_id, code, scope, severity, title, detail, source) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}::error_severity, #{param5}, #{param6}, #{param7}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_state (tenant_id, fingerprint, status, assignee, note, acked_at, closed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, CASE WHEN #{param3} = 'acked' THEN now() END, CASE WHEN #{param3} = 'closed' THEN now() END, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, assignee = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.assignee, alert_state.assignee), note = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.note, alert_state.note), acked_at = COALESCE(alert_state.acked_at, EXCLUDED.acked_at), closed_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'closed' THEN now() ELSE alert_state.closed_at END, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: INSERT INTO position_evidence (tenant_id, plate_barcode, resource_id, evidence_type, run_id, operator, note) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6}, #{param7}) RETURNING id

WITH nd AS ( SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name", estimate_sec AS "manual", resource_id AS "resourceId", params->>'protocol_name' AS "method", COALESCE(seq, 2147483647) AS ord, id FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task' ), hist AS ( SELECT cmd.method, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cmd.finished_at - cmd.sent_at))) AS p50, count(*) AS n FROM run_command cmd WHERE cmd.tenant_id = #{param1} AND cmd.method IN (SELECT "method" FROM nd WHERE "method" IS NOT NULL) AND cmd.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND cmd.sent_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cmd.method ) SELECT nd."nodeKey", nd."name", nd."manual", nd."resourceId", nd."method", hist.p50 AS "p50", hist.n AS "n", (SELECT max(dm.estimate_sec) FROM device_method dm WHERE dm.method = nd."method" AND dm.estimate_sec > 0) AS "devEst" FROM nd LEFT JOIN hist ON hist.method = nd."method" ORDER BY nd.ord, nd.id
SELECT experiment_id AS "experimentId", status AS "status", expanded_steps AS "expandedSteps" FROM experiment_run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT p.seq AS "seq", p.workflow_id AS "workflowId", p.loop_count AS "loopCount", w.name AS "name" FROM experiment_process p LEFT JOIN workflow w ON w.id = p.workflow_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY p.seq
SELECT seq AS "seq", loop_index AS "loopIndex", status AS "status", run_id AS "runId", error AS "error" FROM experiment_run_step WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_run_id = #{param2}
INSERT INTO resource_node (tenant_id, parent_id, code, name, kind, path, sort_order) VALUES (#{param1}, NULL, #{param2}, #{param3}, 'island', #{param4}, 100) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO intervention_record (tenant_id, manual_window_id, run_id, experiment_run_id, operator, decided_action, plate_barcode, sample_id, from_location, to_location, result, note) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6}, #{param7}, #{param8}, #{param9}, #{param10}, #{param11}, #{param12}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO experiment_handoff (tenant_id, experiment_id, from_workcell_id, to_workcell_id, carrier, status) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, 'manual', 'configured') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, experiment_id, from_workcell_id, to_workcell_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO experiment_workcell (tenant_id, experiment_id, workcell_id, source) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, 'binding') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, experiment_id, workcell_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: INSERT INTO experiment (tenant_id, experiment_no, name, status, priority, island_id, planned_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, 'created', #{param4}, #{param5}, now()) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET role = COALESCE(#{param3}, role), enabled = COALESCE(#{param4}, enabled), password_hash = COALESCE(#{param5}, password_hash), salt = COALESCE(#{param6}, salt) WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO robot_point (tenant_id, island_id, robot_resource_id, code, name, x, y, z, device_resource_id, action, synced_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6}, #{param7}, #{param8}, #{param9}, #{param10}, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, robot_resource_id, code) DO UPDATE SET name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, robot_point.name), x = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.x, robot_point.x), y = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.y, robot_point.y), z = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.z, robot_point.z), device_resource_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.device_resource_id, robot_point.device_resource_id), action = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.action, robot_point.action), updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_node SET parent_id = NULL, path = '/' || code, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND kind = 'device'
UPDATE resource_node SET parent_id = #{param3}, path = #{param4}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2} AND kind = 'device'
mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.run_id AS "runId", n.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", n.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.run_no AS "runNo", res.code AS "resCode", GREATEST(0, COALESCE(n.estimate_sec, 0) - COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - n.actual_start)), 0)) AS "remain" FROM run_node n JOIN run r ON r.id = n.run_id LEFT JOIN resource_node res ON res.id = n.resource_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.resource_id = #{param2} AND n.level = 0 AND n.status = 'running' AND r.status = 'running' ORDER BY "remain" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.attendance AS "attendance", r.actual_start AS "actualStart", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0) AS "total", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'completed') AS "done", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'manual') AS "manual", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'failed') AS "failed" FROM run r LEFT JOIN run_node n ON n.run_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.status = 'running' GROUP BY r.id, r.run_no, r.attendance, r.actual_start ORDER BY r.actual_start DESC

SELECT id AS "id", run_no AS "runNo", run_type AS "runType", pause_kind AS "pauseKind", pause_reason AS "pauseReason", pause_node_key AS "pauseNodeKey", status::text AS "status", priority AS "priority", attendance AS "attendance", actual_start AS "actualStart", actual_end AS "actualEnd", created_at AS "createdAt", input::text AS "input" FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT rn.id AS "id", rn.node_key AS "nodeKey", rn.name AS "name", rn.status::text AS "status", rn.attempt AS "attempt", rn.resource_id AS "resourceId", rn.capability_id AS "capabilityId", rn.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", res.code AS "resourceCode", level AS "level", parent_node_id AS "parentNodeId", step_seq AS "stepSeq", loop_index AS "loopIndex", input->>'reason' AS "reason", rn.error_code AS "errorCode" FROM run_node rn LEFT JOIN resource_node res ON res.id = rn.resource_id WHERE rn.run_id = #{param1} ORDER BY COALESCE(rn.parent_node_id, rn.id), rn.loop_index, rn.level, COALESCE(rn.step_seq, 0), rn.id

SELECT occurred_at AS "at", event_type AS "type", payload::text AS "payload" FROM run_event WHERE aggregate_type = 'run' AND aggregate_id = #{param1} ORDER BY COALESCE((payload->>'seq')::int, 0) LIMIT 100
SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task' ORDER BY id
SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name", status::text AS "status", error_code AS "errorCode" FROM run_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND run_id = #{param2} AND level = 0 AND loop_index = 0

SELECT e.id AS "id", e.experiment_no AS "experimentNo", e.name AS "name", e.status AS "status", e.version AS "version", e.priority AS "priority", e.planned_at AS "plannedAt", e.started_at AS "startedAt", e.finished_at AS "finishedAt", e.remark AS "remark", e.workflow_id AS "workflowId", w.name AS "workflowName", isl.code AS "islandCode", isl.name AS "islandName", (SELECT string_agg(rn.name, '、' ORDER BY rn.name) FROM experiment_workcell ew JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.id = ew.workcell_id WHERE ew.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND ew.experiment_id = e.id) AS "workcellNames", (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_process p WHERE p.experiment_id = e.id) AS "flowCount" FROM experiment e LEFT JOIN workflow w ON w.id = e.workflow_id LEFT JOIN resource_node isl ON isl.id = e.island_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT id AS "id", node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name", status::text AS "status", level AS "level", parent_node_id AS "parentNodeId", step_seq AS "stepSeq", resource_id AS "resourceId", loop_index AS "loopIndex", actual_start AS "actualStart", actual_end AS "actualEnd", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (actual_end - actual_start)) * 1000 AS "durMs" FROM run_node WHERE run_id = #{param1} AND actual_start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_node_id, id), level, COALESCE(step_seq, 0), id

SELECT p.id AS "id", p.workflow_id AS "workflowId", p.seq AS "seq", p.run_mode AS "runMode", p.run_after AS "runAfter", p.loop_count AS "loopCount", w.name AS "workflowName", w.code AS "workflowCode", (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = p.workflow_id AND n.node_type = 'task') AS "nodeCount" FROM experiment_process p JOIN workflow w ON w.id = p.workflow_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY p.seq

SELECT p.id AS "id", COALESCE(ec.code, '*') AS "code", p.scope AS "scope", p.strategy::text AS "strategy", p.max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", p.priority AS "priority", p.enabled AS "enabled", COALESCE(p.params->>'origin', 'manual') AS "origin" FROM recovery_policy p LEFT JOIN error_code ec ON ec.id = p.error_code_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY p.priority, p.id

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.run_type AS "runType", r.status::text AS "status", r.priority AS "priority", r.attendance AS "attendance", r.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.actual_end AS "actualEnd", r.created_at AS "createdAt", (SELECT count(*) FROM run_node n WHERE n.run_id = r.id AND n.loop_index = 0) AS "nodeCount" FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.name AS "name", n.status::text AS "status", n.attempt AS "attempt", n.resource_id AS "resourceId", n.input->>'reason' AS "reason", (SELECT string_agg(c2.method, ' → ' ORDER BY c2.command_seq) FROM run_command c2 WHERE c2.run_node_id = n.id) AS "steps" FROM run_node n WHERE n.run_id = #{param1} AND n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status NOT IN ('completed', 'skipped') ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.status::text AS "status", r.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.actual_end AS "actualEnd", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.actual_end - r.actual_start)) AS "durationSec", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0) AS "total", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'completed') AS "done", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'manual') AS "manual", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'failed') AS "failed" FROM run r LEFT JOIN run_node n ON n.run_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id = #{param2} GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT GREATEST(0, COALESCE(n.estimate_sec, 0) - COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - n.actual_start)), 0)) AS "remain" FROM run_node n JOIN run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.resource_id = #{param2} AND n.level = 0 AND n.status = 'running' AND r.status = 'running' ORDER BY "remain" DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE experiment_process SET loop_count = #{param4} WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} AND seq = #{param3}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", type AS "type", default_value AS "defaultValue", description AS "description" FROM experiment_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY id

SELECT dm.method AS "method", dm.name AS "name", c.code AS "capability", dm.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", dm.timeout_sec AS "timeoutSec", dm.interruptible AS "interruptible", dm.param_schema->'params' AS "params" FROM device_instance di JOIN device_method dm ON dm.device_id = di.device_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dm.capability_id WHERE di.resource_id = #{param1} ORDER BY dm.method
SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name" FROM capability ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id
